items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: When Louis Jordan, then came King Cole. When he made "Nature Boy," you found him in every hotel in the country.

ctx.x: What year? It was around '50. From '40, it started falling to pieces. When Louis Jordan come out with the Tympany Five, with them little bands, down to five... He could play them big old ballrooms with the Tympany Five...
King Cole and all of 'em come out with them trios, too...
He'd (?) them and put up the five mikes. When Louis Jordan came out with "Do You Call That A Party".
